defects.binary search never terminates: tierRate's loop sets lo = mid; when hi = lo + 1 and tiers[mid].min <= amount, mid == lo and the loop never terminates.
defects.refill rate divided twice: refillPerMs is already divided by 1000 and is multiplied by elapsed seconds, so the bucket refills 1000 times too slowly.
defects.eviction on update: set evicts the least recently used entry when the cache is full even if the key already exists, so updating an existing key drops another entry.
defects.percentile p=1 out of range: percentile indexes sorted[floor(p * length)], which is past the end (undefined) for p = 1.
